server.user.create_role_grant_failed: The account was created but granting the admin role failed. The account is usable; the initial password was not returned — use "Reset password" to generate one and grant the role later.
server.user.status_invalid: status accepts only Active or Frozen.
server.user.self_status_forbidden: Freezing yourself would lock your current admin session out immediately, and a frozen account cannot sign in to any endpoint.
server.user.self_password_reset_forbidde: An admin reset signs the target account out everywhere (including your current admin session). Use the self-service password flow to change your own password.
server.user.password_invalid: The new password does not meet the policy.
server.user.roles_invalid: Roles must not be empty and must not contain blank entries.
server.user.self_role_removal_forbidden: After removal your next token refresh would be rejected and you could not re-enter the console. Ask another administrator.
server.user.roles_partial_failure: The partially applied change has been audit-logged and tokens revoked; the current roles are whatever the detail endpoint returns.
server.user.unlock_count_reset_failed: Failed to reset the failed-attempt count.
server.user.self_revoke_forbidden: This would revoke your current admin session tokens. Use sign-out to end your own session.
server.user.profile_invalid: The request body must not be empty.
server.user.deactivate_confirm_mismatch: The confirmation username does not match.
server.user.self_deactivate_forbidden: Deactivating your own account would end your current admin session.
server.user.deleted: This account is deactivated (terminal state); it cannot be changed. Recovery requires direct database access.
server.client.redirect_uris_required: Clearing RedirectUris would leave the client unable to complete any login callback.
server.client.permissions_required: A client without any permissions cannot authenticate against any endpoint.
server.client.permission_unknown: Not in the server allowlist (GET admin-api/clients/options returns the catalog).
server.client.not_confidential: Public clients (PKCE) have no secret to rotate.
